name: A delivered app that runs out of stack ends with a plain message, the Fidget stays up, and Back returns to the menu
reviewer_setup: A local_test build. deep_probe.wasm (source: wasm/device_module/bench/deep_probe.c) recurses 16 levels deeper every frame and, at the bottom, draws text, logs 'probe depth=<n>' and calls a never-before-called 64-case switch (compiled right there), until the native-stack guard stops it. Check the screencap: the app name, 'stopped: out of memory', 'press any button'.
